caption: kart racing through the theme park - space mountain as a track is exactly as good as it sounds.
about: Walt disney world quest: magical racing tour (2000) is the rare theme-park kart racer done with care: crystal dynamics built tracks out of the parks themselves - space mountain, splash mountain, test track - with ride-accurate theming and honest kart handling. The park-faithful track design remains the game's whole magic trick.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps1 - played through duckstation, rom sourced from romsfun.
